prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Learn how to interact, minimize, move, or chat with your mascot directly on your desktop screen.", "Right-click pet for instant actions & settings", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P to hide or summon your pet anytime"]
1: ["Select Mascot Friend", "Listen to Voice Preview"]
2: ["Choose Your Pet's Role & Personality", "Select how your mascot companion will interact with you during daily desktop tasks.", "Companion Path - Friendly desktop presence"]
3: ["Sign In to Restore Existing Pets", "Verify your email to automatically sync past pets, custom creations, and save states.", "Existing Pet Data Saved in Cloud"]
4: ["Upload clear, well-lit photos facing forward with clear contrast for best rendering results."]
5: ["Preparing Mascot Desktop Overlay", "Checking screen resolution, monitor configuration, and desktop permission settings...", "Desktop Window Layer Permitted"]
6: ["Begin Your Adventure & Claim Starter Gear", "Includes Starter Accessory Bundle"]
7: ["Find your mascot icon in the system tray at the bottom right to keep pet active background.", "Pin app to system tray so your pet is always one click away"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Seal"]
9: ["Sign In to Restore Your Saved Pets", "Connecting your account automatically recovers your previous pets, progress, and custom desktop preferences."]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (photos of user)
